answer: LIST st, c, z, sta FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO has SchoolStreet st AND ALSO has SchoolCity c AND ALSO has SchoolZip z AND ALSO has SchoolState sta AND ALSO (g / t) AS rate WHERE t > 0 ORDERED WITH rate ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n, e FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: '31'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolGSoffered g AND ALSO has SchoolLongitude lo AND ALSO abs(lo) AS al ORDERED WITH al DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, doc FROM Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType doc AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a AND ALSO (k - a) AS diff WHERE diff > THE AVERAGE d IN (Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS d)
note: 'locally funded' matched against FrpmCharterFundingType (the per-school charter funding classification, populated for charter schools). School also carries a SchoolFundingType with the identical value domain; if the question intends that field instead, substitute it throughout.

answer: LIST n FROM Frpm has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 f AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE (f / k) > 0.1 AND g >= 1
LIST c, cnt FROM School e [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c AND ALSO THE COUNT OF e GROUPED BY c AS cnt WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH cnt DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
